definitions.gloss: subordinate; follower; person under one's command
definitions.explanation: A person who serves under someone else's authority or command. Also used to describe the state of being under someone's control.

examples.japanese: ⟦{将軍|しょうぐん}→将軍：12386_shougun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{配下|はいか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{武士|ぶし}→武士：03989_bushi⟧がいた。
examples.english: Many warriors served under the shogun.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{配下|はいか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}かれた→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: He was placed under the organization's control.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{配下|はいか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧{精鋭|せいえい}⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The elite team directly under the president's command will handle this project.

notes:
Describes someone under another's authority, or the state of being under someone's control. Has a formal, somewhat hierarchical tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {配下|はいか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧ (to place under one's command)
- {配下|はいか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (to come under someone's command)
- ⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{配下|はいか} (directly under one's command)
- {配下|はいか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧ (one's subordinates)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {配下|はいか}: subordinate (formal, emphasizes hierarchical position)
- ⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧: subordinate (standard business/workplace term)
- ⟦{手下|てした}→手下：12940_teshita⟧: underling (more negative, gang/criminal nuance)
- ⟦{家来|けらい}→家来：12397_kerai⟧: retainer (historical, feudal context)
